title: Anti-blocking admission
description: Objective: enforce dependency necessity, approved-interface alternatives, semantic reduction, plan quality, and bounded blocker challenge before multi-node activation. Deliverable: scheduler admission modules with counterexamples. NOT in scope: execution dispatch or automatic graph rewrite. Hard dependencies: Dependency contract kernel. Owned paths: packages/scheduler/src/admission/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test.
definitionOfDone: Unnecessary hard edges are rejected or held with stable reasons.
Interface-first alternatives and intentional waits are represented without inventing readiness.
Admission is deterministic and never auto-removes a semantic edge.
taskRails: Graph Beta cannot activate until the proven Foundation runner contracts it consumes are green.
A dependency, readiness, fairness, or semantic claim without daemon-verifiable evidence is UNKNOWN or refused.
Keep tasks file-disjoint where possible; order is a presentation hint, not a fabricated hard dependency.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400; explicit paths only and no sibling worktree.

implementationPlan.description: TDD red — src/admission/admission-pass.test.ts. The 8-step design-396 matrix, with EXPLICIT step allocation (QA-verifiable, no silent drops): STEP 1 — structural members (self-edge, cycle, missing endpoint, duplicates, completion codes) are REUSED from validateGraphSnapshot verbatim (assert pass-through of GRAPH_* issues, no re-implementation, no duplicate ADMISSION_* codes for the same facts); genuinely admission-local step-1 additions each get a stable ADMISSION_* code + test: cross-snapshot input, incompatible contract (contract fields vs edge endpoints/kind disagree), stale fact (source-fact versions older than declared current), duplicate contract (two contracts for one edge); STEP 2 — ADMISSION_HARD_DEPENDENCY_UNPROVEN when a hard edge lacks its current typed contract (no collision with landed frontier HARD_DEPENDENCY_UNSATISFIED/UNKNOWN codes); same-epic/prose-order/same-repo/ownership/resource-scarcity witnesses each REJECTED as proof (design 399); STEP 3 — minimum-milestone: depending on full ACCEPTED is INVALID when the contract's minimumQualifyingMilestone + an INTERFACE_AVAILABLE/FIXTURE_AVAILABLE ruling shows an earlier milestone satisfies the consumer (design 400); STEP 4 — EXPLICIT: contract-level semantic transitive reduction with the PINNED LICENSING CONDITION — a proposal-refusal (ADMISSION_EDGE_SEMANTICALLY_REDUNDANT) is licensed ONLY when the kernel ContractRedundancyAssessment shows FULL identity along the alternate path: producer-arm identity AND predicate identity AND invalidation/horizon identity (design 396.4 'identical input/predicate and invalidation semantics'); ANY partial equivalence -> reviewOnly RECORD, never refusal; refusing a PROPOSAL is distinct from removing a landed edge, so the kernel's requiresSemanticProof:true fence is never contradicted — assert the assessment object passes through unmodified; a direct artifact edge an intermediate does not reproduce stays VALID; STEP 5 — completion closure reused (COMPLETION_CLOSURE_INCOMPLETE pass-through); STEP 6 — baseline comparison: structural half DERIVED from analyzeGraphStructure outputs (structuralStageCount, criticalPathHardEdges, hardDescendantCount, null-not-zero widths — assert admission NEVER recomputes its own critical path); estimate half = VALIDATED caller-supplied truth-classed duration/cost fields (planner proposes, core validates — design 392/447/457); UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN, never zero, never a speed claim; STEP 7 — interface-first record = composition of landed INTERFACE_FIRST_REVIEW_REQUIRED StructuralDiagnostic edges × kernel alternative ruling × design-404 stub constraints (non-production, hash-bound to approved interface contract, producer+consumer conformance recipes, replaced/verified at integration) — RECORD only, no stub generation, no second serial-edge detector; STEP 8 — 24-node/64-hard-edge limits REUSED from landed GRAPH_NODE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED/GRAPH_HARD_EDGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (assert pass-through, no new codes); depth-3/child-width-6/nine-per-expansion are expansion-LINEAGE facts owned by the Expansion admission protocol task — admission ships ONLY a pure checker parameterized by caller-supplied expansion-lineage facts plus an R2-raise reference record. J6/CORE-S13 shapes: naked A->B->C->D refused with corrected-frontier evidence via landed analyzeHardEdgeCounterfactuals output; interface-first variant admits with the milestone edge retained. Determinism: same inputs -> byte-identical frozen results. Confirm RED.

implementationPlan.description: Green — src/admission/admission-pass.ts (+ one-line shim admission-pass.js). COMPOSITION MECHANICS (verified): GraphStructureView is package-internal — the reuse surface is validateGraphSnapshot (returns ValidatedGraph | issues), analyzeGraphStructure (REQUIRES in-process provenance — admission runs validateGraphSnapshot itself on BOTH the proposed snapshot AND the sequential-baseline snapshot before analysis, else GraphAnalysisError), partitionFrontier, and analyzeHardEdgeCounterfactuals; findRedundancyCandidates is NOT directly callable (internal params) — structural candidates arrive via GraphStructuralAnalysis.structuralRedundancyCandidates. Admission-local additions implemented with dependencies-local-convention helpers (local ADMISSION_* closed code union, local makeIssue/sortIssues/deepFreeze clones, runtime-shape hostile-input helpers via '../runtime-shape.js'). Inputs: validated proposed graph + baseline + DependencyContracts (kernel validateDependencyContract run per contract first) + caller-supplied truth-classed estimates + optional expansion-lineage facts. Output: deep-frozen AdmissionResult { ok: true, records: {baseline, interfaceFirst[], reduction[], counterfactuals} } | { ok: false, issues } — records are evidence artifacts, distinct from refusals. Target <=250, split before 400 (likely split: admission-records.ts via amendment). Step-2 tests green.

TDD red then green — src/admission/admission-necessity.ts (+ shim) + tests folded into admission-pass.test.ts or a focused block. RESOLVED (no open questions in an approved plan): positive controls are a TEST-TIME obligation (design 409 'Admission PROPERTIES include matched positive controls'; running consumer oracles is impossible in a pure pass, design 392) — admission NEVER refuses a graph for missing counterexample bundles. What admission-necessity DOES: (1) typed per-edge outcomes for agent-claimed necessity (design 407): AGENT_REPORTED 'why necessary' NEVER admits a hard edge — outcomes are (a) ADMISSIBLE via daemon-verifiable witness (truthClass floor DAEMON_VERIFIED), (b) ADMISSION_HELD_FOR_HUMAN_DECISION — the typed HELD outcome DoD 1 requires ('rejected or HELD with stable reasons'): a pure RECORD carrying the pending edge-specific human decision ref + the would-be POLICY_SEQUENCE conversion (with added stages/critical-path cost from the landed structural analysis) — NO lifecycle transitions, no Blocker/PlanningHold states (kernel fence); (c) REFUSED or DOWNGRADED-to-advisory; human approval records the decision but does not upgrade the underlying fact's truth class (design 398); (2) AdmissionCounterexample as an OPTIONAL validated evidence SHAPE (digest-bound fixture refs, matched per-edge, false-edge fixtures) consumed by the TEST matrix — shape validation only, outcome truth stays at supplied truthClass; (3) reuse landed analyzeHardEdgeCounterfactuals (dependencyNecessity UNKNOWN, requiresSemanticProof, reviewOnly) as the structural counterfactual record — never redefined. Property obligations in tests: for every admitted graph fixture, removing each known-required edge flips the counterfactual/readiness evidence; every false-edge fixture refuses — the positive-control matrix lives HERE in the tests (CORE-S13/J6), not as runtime input demands.

TDD red then green — src/admission/admission-wait.ts (+ shim) + src/admission/admission-invariants.test.ts. admission-wait SHARPENED FENCE (representation + admission-time validation ONLY): IntentionalWait record per design 235 (explicit owner/reason, typed predicate, affected scope, recheckAt/deadline, escalation policy, graph/fact binding) with shape validation; bounded blocker-challenge admission records reusing kernel DependencyChallenge types (dedup by contract/edge hash + graph epoch + source-fact versions; SEMANTIC_PREREQUISITE must reference an existing current hard contract — design 419 puts that reference 'in the same cycle, redundancy, freshness, and completion-closure admission as the graph', which IS this module); time-only-suppression expressed ONLY as a pure predicate helper over supplied facts (isTimeChallengeSuppressed(wait, now, newEvidenceFlag) — new evidence always wins, design 415). EXPLICITLY OUT (named in module header): challenge enqueueing and timer/transaction re-evaluation (readiness engine task-fa96b81c consumes these types), Blocker record lifecycle (design 234), supersession carry of wait/blocker projections (graph supersession task), any readiness computation (landed frontier.ts). admission-invariants.test.ts (seeded xorshift properties): no admission path ever auto-removes an edge (outputs are refusals/records only); AGENT_REPORTED never admits a hard edge across random truth-class permutations; partial contract equivalence NEVER refuses (only full identity does); UNKNOWN estimates never become zero; HELD outcomes carry no state-transition fields; deterministic frozen outputs; hostile inputs refused.

planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Landed reuse surface (verified file:line): validateGraphSnapshot returns ValidatedGraph|issues (GraphStructureView is package-internal by design); analyzeGraphStructure THROWS without in-process provenance — admission validates BOTH proposed and baseline snapshots itself; structuralRedundancyCandidates arrive via GraphStructuralAnalysis (findRedundancyCandidates takes internal params, not directly callable); analyzeHardEdgeCounterfactuals (hard-edge-counterfactual.ts) IS the landed structural counterfactual record (dependencyNecessity UNKNOWN, reviewOnly) — reuse, never redefine; INTERFACE_FIRST_REVIEW_REQUIRED StructuralDiagnostic + minGatedDescendantsForReview threshold land in analyze-graph/graph-policy; frontier codes HARD_DEPENDENCY_UNSATISFIED/UNKNOWN exist — the new code is ADMISSION_HARD_DEPENDENCY_UNPROVEN (design 399, distinct semantic). Genuinely admission-local: cross-snapshot input, incompatible contract, stale fact, duplicate contract, contract-identity reduction, minimum-milestone, necessity outcomes, wait/challenge records. Semantic-reduction licensing pinned: refusal ONLY on FULL identity (producer-arm AND predicate AND invalidation/horizon) from ContractRedundancyAssessment; partial -> record. Fan-out gate: admission owns ONLY the Flow precondition (447); scope/oracle/budget belong to the expansion-protocol/policy/budget task composition; EXPANSION_REFUSED assembly is theirs. Shared-tree hazard: kernel worker's TDD RED tests share the package test filter — step gates are path-scoped to src/admission; full filter only at completion with attribution (gotcha-shared-tree-repo-gate).
planningNotes.risks: (1) Kernel-surface drift is the top schedule risk: kernel is WORKING now and commits at its final step; the gate's task-DONE + symbol-probe + completion re-run handles land-then-QA-reject windows — worker must never adapt silently to a changed surface, report_blocked instead. (2) Duplicate-code divergence: every structural/limit fact must be a pass-through; the step-7 adversarial audit greps ADMISSION_* vs GRAPH_*/frontier codes. (3) Over-refusal on partial contract equivalence would let admission delete-by-refusal what the kernel refuses to authorize — the full-identity licensing condition + property test guard it. (4) Positive-control scope creep: any runtime demand for counterexample bundles refuses legitimate submissions — test-time only. (5) HELD outcome must stay a record — any status/transition field re-invents Blocker lifecycle the kernel fences out. (6) Package test filter is shared with three in-flight scheduler subtrees — path-scoped gates during work; attribution at completion. (7) Estimates: any code path that turns UNKNOWN into 0 or a speed claim violates design 403 — property-tested.
